title: Claude Desktop App: Cowork tab stuck on 'Sending request' - UUID validation error
body:
## Description

The Cowork tab in Claude Desktop App (v1.1.381) is stuck on "Sending request..." and eventually shows "API Error: Connection error". The Chat tab works fine, as does claude.ai in browser and Claude Code CLI.

**This was working approximately one week ago.**

## Environment

- **App Version**: 1.1.381
- **Platform**: macOS Darwin 25.1.0 (Apple Silicon arm64)
- **Claude Code CLI**: 2.1.15 (works fine)

## Error Logs

From `~/Library/Logs/Claude/claude.ai-web.log`:

```
[REACT_QUERY_CLIENT] QueryClient error: Error: path.conversation_uuid: Input should be a valid UUID, invalid character: expected an optional prefix of `urn:uuid:` followed by [0-9a-fA-F-], found `l` at 1
```

```
Refused to connect to 'https://a-api.anthropic.com/v1/m' because it violates the following Content Security Policy directive
```

```
[REACT_QUERY_CLIENT] QueryClient error: Error: Invalid authorization
```

## Steps to Reproduce

1. Open Claude Desktop App
2. Go to Cowork tab
3. Send any message
4. Observe "Sending request..." that never completes, then "API Error: Connection error"

## What Works

- Chat tab in the same app ✅
- claude.ai in browser ✅
- Claude Code CLI ✅
- VM starts and connects successfully ✅

## Troubleshooting Attempted

- Full app reinstall (deleted and re-downloaded)
- Cleared all app data, cache, preferences, keychain
- Verified network connectivity to api.anthropic.com (works)
- Verified Anthropic status page shows all systems operational

## Analysis

The error suggests the Cowork feature is passing local session IDs (prefixed with "local_") where the backend expects a proper UUID.

top_comments.body: Me too. What's even stranger is that whenever the Claude App Cowork hangs, it also blocks my Claude Code. I have to clear my firewall rules again to make it work.
